# ツミアゲ (Tsumiage) — savings challenges for iPhone

> ツミアゲ（App Store 名「ツミアゲ貯金：貯金チャレンジ・目標貯金」; English/Korean name "Tsumiage") is an iPhone app (iOS 26 or later) for savings challenges and savings goals. You set a numeric goal and stack up records toward it with one tap. No ads, no account, no data collection. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6821537539

## Facts
- Challenges in the app: 52週貯金 (52-week), 365日貯金 (365-day), 100日貯金 (100-day), 500円玉貯金 (200 coins), 100封筒チャレンジ (100 envelope), つもり貯金 (no-spend savings with one-tap buttons such as 「コーヒーをがまん ¥500」).
- Also tracks distance, books, study time, counts and custom units; timer logging with a Live Activity.
- Typing a goal name such as 「沖縄旅行 20万円 12月までに」 or "Hawaii trip $2,000 by December" sets kind, target and deadline and shows the per-day pace.
- One-tap logging from Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, Control Center, Shortcuts and Siri.
- Charts, medals and badges, withdrawals, edit and undo. Optional notifications: daily reminder, payday, weekly review, deadline pace.
- Data stays on the iPhone; optional daily automatic backup to the user's own iCloud Drive, restore after reinstall, CSV import. The developer receives no data.
- Pricing model: core features work without purchase (3 active goals, all challenges, widgets, backup). "ツミアゲ Pro / Tsumiage Pro" is a one-time in-app purchase (no subscription): unlimited goals, recurring deposit reminders (定期積立), all chart and widget styles, detailed analysis, Face ID lock, CSV export. Family Sharing supported. Prices vary by country and are shown in the App Store.
- Languages: Japanese, English, Korean.

## Challenge maths (exact)
- 52週貯金: ¥100 in week 1, +¥100 each week, ¥5,200 in week 52; total ¥137,800 = 100 × (1+…+52). Variants: ¥10 steps → ¥13,780; ¥1,000 steps → ¥1,378,000.
- 52-week money challenge (US): $1 steps → $1,378; $5 steps → $6,890; $10 steps → $13,780.
- 52주 저금 챌린지 (Korea): ₩1,000 steps → ₩1,378,000.
- 365日貯金: ¥1 to ¥365, one square a day; total ¥66,795 (366 squares in a leap year: ¥67,161).
- 100日貯金: ¥1 to ¥100; total ¥5,050. Variants: ¥10 units → ¥50,500; ¥100 units → ¥505,000.
- 500円玉貯金: 200 coins × ¥500 = ¥100,000 (20 coins = ¥10,000; 100 coins = ¥50,000).
- 100封筒チャレンジ (日本円版): envelope n holds n × ¥100; total ¥505,000. Original US version: n × $1 = $5,050. Korea: n × ₩1,000 = ₩5,050,000.
- つもり貯金 example: skipping a ¥500 coffee 3 times a week = ¥6,000 a month, ¥78,000 in 52 weeks.

## Pages
- [ツミアゲ貯金：貯金チャレンジ・目標貯金](https://zhao73.github.io/tsumiage-support/): 52週貯金・365日貯金・500円玉貯金・100封筒チャレンジ・つもり貯金を、マスを埋めて記録する iPhone アプリ。広告なし・買い切り・登録なし。各チャレンジのやり方と印刷できる表（PDF）も公開しています。
- [52週貯金のやり方と表（無料PDF）](https://zhao73.github.io/tsumiage-support/52shuu/): 52週貯金は1週目に100円、毎週100円ずつ増やして52週目に5,200円。1年で合計137,800円貯まります。やり方、計算の早見表、続けるコツ、印刷できるA4の表（PDF）をまとめました。
- [365日貯金のやり方と表（無料PDF）](https://zhao73.github.io/tsumiage-support/365nichi/): 365日貯金は1円から365円までを1日1マスずつ貯める方法で、1年の合計は66,795円。やり方、早見表、うるう年の場合、印刷できるA4の表（PDF）をまとめました。
- [100日貯金のやり方と表（無料PDF）](https://zhao73.github.io/tsumiage-support/100nichi/): 100日貯金は1日目1円、2日目2円と増やして100日目に100円。合計5,050円です。1マス10円なら50,500円、100円なら505,000円。やり方と印刷できるA4の表（PDF）を紹介します。
- [500円玉貯金はいくら貯まる？表（無料PDF）](https://zhao73.github.io/tsumiage-support/500en/): 500円玉貯金は200枚で10万円。20枚で1万円、100枚で5万円です。枚数と金額の早見表、重さの目安、続けるコツ、200枚を塗りつぶせるA4の表（PDF）をまとめました。
- [100封筒チャレンジのやり方と表（日本円版）](https://zhao73.github.io/tsumiage-support/100futo/): 100封筒チャレンジは1〜100の番号の封筒に「番号×単位」の金額を入れる貯金法。1封筒100円なら合計505,000円、元のアメリカ版は1ドル単位で5,050ドル。やり方と印刷できるA4の表（PDF）。
- [つもり貯金のやり方とリスト例（無料PDF）](https://zhao73.github.io/tsumiage-support/tsumori/): つもり貯金は「買ったつもり」で浮いたお金を貯める方法。コーヒーを週3回がまんすると1杯500円で月6,000円、1年で78,000円。がまんリストの例と、記録用のA4シート（PDF）を紹介します。
- [Tsumiage — savings challenges for iPhone](https://zhao73.github.io/tsumiage-support/en/): An iPhone app for savings challenges and goals: 52-week, 100 envelope, 365-day and more. Fill squares with one tap from widgets. No ads, one-time Pro, no sign-up. Free printable charts included.
- [52-Week Money Challenge: printable chart](https://zhao73.github.io/tsumiage-support/en/52-week-money-challenge/): The 52-week money challenge: save $1 in week 1 and add $1 every week. Week 52 is $52 and the total is $1,378. How it works, the maths, four ways to play and a free printable A4 chart (PDF).
- [100 Envelope Challenge: printable chart](https://zhao73.github.io/tsumiage-support/en/100-envelope-challenge/): The 100 envelope challenge: number envelopes 1 to 100 and put $n in envelope n. The total is $5,050 — 100 days at one a day. How it works, the maths and a free printable A4 chart (PDF).
- [Tsumiage — 저축 챌린지·저축 목표](https://zhao73.github.io/tsumiage-support/ko/): 52주 저금, 100봉투 챌린지 같은 저축 챌린지와 목표 저축을 칸을 채우며 기록하는 iPhone 앱. 광고 없음, 1회 구매, 가입 없음. 챌린지 방법과 인쇄용 표(PDF)도 있어요.
- [52주 저금 챌린지 표 (무료 PDF)](https://zhao73.github.io/tsumiage-support/ko/52ju-jeogeum/): 52주 저금 챌린지는 1주 차에 1,000원, 매주 1,000원씩 늘려 52주 차에 52,000원을 모으는 방법이에요. 1년 합계는 1,378,000원. 방법, 계산표, 인쇄용 A4 표(PDF)를 정리했어요.
- [100봉투 챌린지 방법과 표 (무료 PDF)](https://zhao73.github.io/tsumiage-support/ko/100bongtu/): 100봉투 챌린지는 1~100번 봉투에 "번호 × 1,000원"을 넣는 저축 방법이에요. 100봉투를 다 채우면 5,050,000원. 방법, 계산표, 인쇄용 A4 표(PDF)를 정리했어요.
